recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless PA requests different display-selection criteria or additional Practitioner-specific examples.
issue_request: FHIR-9067 requested Practitioner.name cardinality 0..* so aliases and multiple practitioner names could be represented, plus guidance for selecting the name used in Practitioner reference display values.
initial_application: The issue was applied by 64afb1d0b601aca0cd926438c18e5ca11ddbf6ab, which changed Practitioner.name from 0..1 to 0..* and added guidance for choosing the display name when multiple names are available.
additional_context: FHIR-9067 is tightly linked to FHIR-3500 because FHIR-3500's resolution explicitly noted PA approval to make Practitioner.name repeat. Current HumanName documentation also explains alternate names, nicknames, aliases, old names, and text-versus-parts behavior.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Practitioner source already matches the requested cardinality and guidance.
